blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Pinned Ethereum block 26095794 and Avalanche block 96511142 on 2026-10-01 confirmed asset() is local USDC on both tracked vaults. Ethereum USDC blacklister() returned 0x0a06be16275b95a7d2567fbdae118b36c7da78f9, and Circle's source documents its blacklist authority. The wrapper retains upstream USDC freeze exposure; this does not assert that all deployed strategy positions are held as USDC.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The tracked Ethereum and Avalanche spUSDC deployments are local ERC-4626 USDC vaults behind upgradeable ERC-1967 UUPS proxies, not immutable clones. Pinned reads on 2026-10-01 confirm local USDC assets and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders Spark SubProxy on Ethereum and Spark executor on Avalanche. Wrapper upgrades remain in Mint Authority; these local share contracts are not Avalanche Bridge representations.

routes.reviewNote: At Ethereum block 26095794 on 2026-10-01, the ERC-1967 implementation slot returned 0x1b992302652a92611dcd5090d1cb388c6377f455 and the correct EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. This is a UUPS proxy: a zero transparent-admin slot does not imply immutability. Spark's source restricts upgrades to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, whose member at index 0 was Spark SubProxy 0x3300f198988e4c9c63f75df86de36421f06af8c4. asset() returned Ethereum USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Local share issuance and its upgrade authority are recorded in Mint Authority.

At Avalanche block 96511142 on 2026-10-01, the ERC-1967 implementation slot returned 0xc2c0582d1cce30449cf561c7b9c4d6d527547f12 and the correct EIP-1967 admin slot was zero. This is an upgradeable UUPS proxy, with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member at index 0 Spark executor 0x7566debc906c17338524a414343fa61bca26a843. The official registry identifies its LayerZero receiver as 0xd905be48983D405C6fD7f5a983D2351fb61C691F. asset() returned native USDC 0xb97ef9ef8734c71904d8002f8b6bc66dd9c48a6e. Local share issuance and its upgrade authority are recorded in Mint Authority.
